# Gold 1/2 Inch Hoop Earrings by Studex System 75

## Versatile Gold Hoops for Everyday Style

Add a timeless touch to your look with these 1/2 inch posted gold hoops. Each pair features a 24kt gold electroplate finish over surgical stainless steel, so they pair easily with casual outfits, workwear, or special occasions.

## Gentle on Sensitive Ears

These hypoallergenic hoops are nickel-safe and free of lead, cadmium, and cobalt. Studex System 75 products meet or exceed FDA and European Union standards. Thin 20-gauge posts work like regular earrings, so you can wear them comfortably throughout your day.

## Pierce or Wear in Already-Pierced Ears

Each earring releases easily from the self-piercing cartridge, so you can use the same pair for a new piercing or simply slip them into ears you've already pierced. Every order arrives brand new in a sealed, sterilized blister package, made in the USA.

## Reliable Quality at an Affordable Price

With a 4.2-star average from 43 ratings, these hoops offer dependable value at $11.27. Add a pair to your cart today and enjoy a versatile accessory you can reach for every day.
